'9-1-1: Nashville' cast Jessica Capshaw, Ryan Phillippe tease Season 2

Bryan West, Nashville Tennessean

Thu, October 15, 2026 at 10:06 AM UTC

4 min read

Murder hornets. Snakes. Blood-flooded basements. Music City is about to become a disaster zone inundated with biblical plagues when"9-1-1: Nashville" returns for Season 2.

Ahead of the high-octane ABC drama's Oct. 15 premiere, the cast spoke with The Tennessean, which is part of the USA TODAY Network, on Aug. 2 about the lingering consequences of last season's family feud and the increasingly outlandish emergencies confronting Station 113.

"There's a whole other level of suspense and intrigue and a little sleuthing," says Jessica Capshaw, who plays Blythe Hart. "We gotta finish up some stuff we started, where we left off at the end of Season 1. So we've got that. We got some cleanup."

As '9-1-1: Nashville' returns: Here are local spots that have been featured so far
Season 2 features a rogue arrival

The first season spotlighted familiar Nashville landmarks: a tornado tore through a Kane Brown concert at Ascend Amphitheater, an Airstream dangled from the Korean War Veterans Memorial Bridge, a girl holding a kite was launched into the air at Centennial Park and a deadly waterslide stunt unfolded at Nashville Shores and a fire engulfed Nelson's Green Brier Distillery.

It ended with a brawl between Hart (Capshaw) and Dixie Bennings (LeAnn Rimes), whose tangled history with fire captain Don Hart (Chris O'Donnell) has repeatedly threatened his marriage.
